doc: View lab (docs/view-lab/PLAN.md): the camera's projection per view id, picked by the launch flag --view=<id> (default `top`, the shipped 90-degree orthographic view, bit-identical: no transform is applied). pitch_deg is the camera's angle above the ground (90 = straight down); the ground plane is foreshortened by sin(pitch) on screen y (Camera2D zoom.y), so the mouse unprojects onto the ground through the same canvas transform. height_k scales how far a part's height lifts it up the screen (cos(pitch), the 2.5D actors; 0 = flat). Render only: a view never writes to the sim.
